body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one Light physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn. You also reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 during that time.

surges.html: Extend suppression to the end of your next turn.
Until your next turn, reduce forced movement against you by 2 units.

rider.title: Combo - Guard
rider.html: Enter Willow Stance: you do not lose Combo from the first Core Wound you suffer each round. The Wound and its other consequences still occur.
